2609.17306.title: Mo' Models, Mo' Problems: How to best select model pools when designing Multi-Agent Systems
2609.17306.paper_summary: Multi-agent Systems (MAS) combine multiple model outputs to solve complex reasoning tasks. However, despite rapid growth of available open-source models, there is limited research on how to select optimal model candidates out of this massive pool. We systematically evaluate 8 model selection strategies (including model size, accuracy and answer diversity) across before-generation (routing) and after-generation (majority-voting, LLM-as-a-judge) MAS architectures on challenging scientific benchmarks. Our findings show a significant gap between theoretical oracle potential and actual performance: Expanding candidate pool sizes often degrades performance below that of the top performing base-model. We find that candidate selection within a single model family is the strategy that yields the best relative performance over a standalone model. These results demonstrate that adding arbitrary models to a heterogeneous MAS can introduce system instability, highlighting model selection as a critical design choice for multi-agent systems.
2609.17306.paper_summary_zh: 多代理系統（MAS）結合多個模型輸出以解決複雜的推理任務。<lb/>然而，儘管可用的開源模型迅速增長，但關於如何從這個龐大的池中選擇最佳模型候選者的研究仍然有限。<lb/>我們系統性地評估了8種模型選擇策略（包括模型大小、準確性和答案多樣性），這些策略在生成前（路由）和生成後（多數投票、LLM作為裁判）的MAS架構中，針對具有挑戰性的科學基準進行評估。<lb/>我們的發現顯示理論上預期的最佳潛力與實際表現之間存在顯著差距：擴大候選池的大小往往會使性能降至低於表現最佳的基模型。<lb/>我們發現，在單一模型家族內進行候選選擇是相對於獨立模型能夠產生最佳性能的策略。<lb/>這些結果表明，將任意模型添加到異質MAS中可能會引入系統不穩定性，突顯了模型選擇作為多代理系統的關鍵設計選擇。
